purpose: Two actual sequential entry executions; raw answers preserved without external-review-based rewriting.

execution_context.isolation_note: The two inputs were processed sequentially in this same agent context. The first response and its resource readings remained visible during the second. This is not represented as two context-isolated trials.
execution_context.external_actions: Read-only public reference browsing; no purchases, external messages, submissions, or publications.

timing.first_recorded_at_note: Recorded after reading the original inputs, SKILL and initial reference batch; actual execution started earlier. Not a precise turn-start timestamp.

tool_use.selection_basis: Single-server arrival/service assumptions, hard performance/cash/time constraints, and whether available verification can change a present decision.

tool_use.scope: A single clarification action asking for the timeline of a recent delayed task; no full diagnosis, invented user response, quantitative assumption, or HTML report.

external_sources.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON serialization of the combined web tool response for the two primary references at provenance capture; not a hash of the remote PDF or HTML source bytes.

delivery_checks.readback: Markdown, HTML and first-turn files were read back after writing. HTML was parsed using Python html.parser.
delivery_checks.visual_preview_attempt: cua.createBrowserTab with a file:// URL was rejected by browser security policy, which allows only http/https. No workaround attempted.
delivery_checks.assessment: No pass/fail self-assessment of behavioral correctness is recorded.

answer_revision_policy: Each answer artifact was written once. No external evaluation feedback was read, and no response was revised from review feedback.

inputs.original_request:
我负责一个材料审核窗口，大家总抱怨等得久，可平均处理时间并不长。请帮我理清下一步怎么改，直接给我完整解决方案和HTML，不用再问背景。我希望平均从提交到办完不超过20分钟，在满足条件的方案中尽量少花钱；不能把平均值写成每件的保证，也不要替我定人力价值。
为初步比较，我们暂以长期稳态条件规划：一名审核员持续可用，一条先到先服务队列，无休假、暂停、返工、退出或容量限制，需求源无限；到达是每小时6件的稳定泊松过程，服务时间独立同分布且与到达独立，现为指数服务，平均每件10分钟。现场是否真的符合这些条件仍要核对。候选A购小工具使服务仍为指数，但平均每件7.5分钟；候选B排除重复步骤，使服务时间固定为10分钟，真正的进件不减，其他条件不变。两项互斥，服务效果均是尚待验证的假设。下月工具、材料、实施、复核全包成本A200元，B120元，预算250元；无额外周期成本。今天已经花了15分钟准备这些数据，整个准备和决策任务最多90分钟。余下共同动作：读你的方案10分钟、与同事核对数据及质量条件20分钟、决定并记下实施约定10分钟；A试用设置与核对20分钟，B试用设置与核对15分钟。不要给我再安排未计入的调查或把以后每周预算当作已授权。A、B均不改变现有人员数量。我能接受今天发现候选都不能达到目标，但仍希望知道下一步可协商什么、先做什么。请综合机制、成本、现实不确定性，给方案、实施顺序和重估条件。不要替我购买或通知别人。
我们几个同事天天忙，事情还是越堆越多，我不知道是人手不够还是做事方式有问题，帮我理清一下。
